name: qbx_db_backup
description: FiveM server resource: local MySQL/MariaDB backups for the QBox dashboard

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/server.js && esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/cli.js && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))"
